description.value: The OK Falls Hotel is a combined pub, bar & grill, and boutique hotel in Okanagan Falls, sitting three blocks from the shores of Skaha Lake. The kitchen serves elevated pub fare built around local Okanagan ingredients — burgers, fresh-caught seafood, and comfort plates — in a relaxed setting with a patio. Freshly renovated suites make it a viable overnight stop for cyclists touring the South Okanagan wine corridor.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content (fetched successfully) confirms an active pub, bar & grill, and boutique hotel at 1045 Main Street, Okanagan Falls — but OSM records the address as 1054 Main Street, a discrepancy flagged below. The website mentions 'high-speed Wi-Fi' explicitly for hotel suites. No bike infrastructure, water refill, washrooms, or takeout are explicitly mentioned anywhere in the website text, so those are marked null per evidence rules.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records '1054 Main Street' but the website consistently shows '1045 Main Street' across all pages including the contact page — website value used.
Contact page refers to accommodation as 'Airbnb rooms', which may indicate the hotel operates as a short-term rental listing rather than a conventional hotel, despite OSM tagging it tourism=hotel.
OSM has no phone number on record; phone was sourced entirely from the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active pub, bar & grill, and hotel in a cycling-relevant location three blocks from Skaha Lake — a clear fit for the Food & Drink category. Address discrepancy should be corrected before publishing.
